Certainly! Here are two hints for the given step in the problem:

Hint 1: Consider the role of the regularization term $\lambda g(\vec{	heta})$ in the loss function. How does increasing or decreasing $\lambda$ affect the penalty on the magnitude of $\vec{	heta}$?

Hint 2: Think about the relationship between $\lambda$ and model complexity. A higher $\lambda$ places more emphasis on minimizing $g(\vec{	heta})$. What impact does this have on the values of $	heta_i$ and, consequently, on the complexity of the model?
